name: Muscat
summary: Vespera is a celebration of duality and texture. The right top is crowned with the rich depth of Rosso Levanto marble in a matte finish, while the left top and body contrast elegantly in dark grey elm veneer. Inner panels in soft-toned melamine provide subtle visual relief. Anchoring the piece is a sleek metal base and decorative accents finished in a refined grey powder coat, embodying understated luxury with modern character. 220x45x76
